traits.name: Spider Speak
traits.text: The web lurker can speak with spiders, with the same effects and limitations as speak with animals.

traits.name: Spring upon Prey
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature touches the web lurker's web while the web lurker is on it. Effect Requirement Initiative has not yet been rolled. The web lurker automatically notices the creature and Strides or Climbs before rolling initiative.

traits.name: Web Lurker Venom
traits.text: (poison); Saving Throw DC 19 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 10 rounds Stage 1 1d6 (1d6) poison and flat-footed (1 round) Stage 2 1d6 (1d6) poison, flat-footed, and slowed 1 (1 round)

traits.name: Web Trap
traits.text: A creature hit by the web lurker's web attack is immobilized and stuck to the nearest surface until it succeeds at DC 20 Acrobatics check to Escape.

traits.name: Web Lurker Traps
traits.text: The following traps are some used by web lurkers.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ fangs +11 (poison); Damage 1d8+6 (1d8+6) piercing plus web lurker venom
